title: Contributing
text: tests hermetic: run local release directory never touch network. Mirror published release , point tests : Without release directory suite skips rather fails, check summary line reports passes. CI mirror, additionally exercises real Zenodo path (.github/scripts/zenodo_smoke.R). editing roxygen comments, run devtools::document() man/ NAMESPACE stay step; CI checks package R CMD check.
code: # install.packages("devtools") devtools::load_all() source(".github/scripts/fetch_release.R"); fetch_release("1.6.2", "release") Sys.setenv(LIKING_INITIATIVE_RELEASE_DIR = normalizePath("release")) devtools::test()

title: Contributing
text: Bump Version DESCRIPTION add NEWS.md heading . R CMD build . && R CMD check ---cran likingInitiative_*.tar.gz must report errors, warnings notes. Record check platforms cran-comments.md, tag vX.Y.Z, publish GitHub release, submit CRAN devtools::release(). CRAN requires ASCII R code: accented characters em dashes strings must \uXXXX escapes (tools::showNonASCIIfile() finds ).
